$comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for DEXI-5 flight-controller parameters. The .params files in dexi-5/ are GENERATED from this file by tools/gen-params.mjs. Never hand-edit them. Values sit on top of PX4's 4601_droneblocks_dexi_5 airframe defaults and list only what differs from them.
name: DEXI-5

boardDefaults.$comment: Nothing yet: the 4601 airframe already sets ports and RC input for the ARK Pi6X.

indoor-flow-nav.doc: Optical flow + rangefinder, no GPS. Rangefinder is the height reference with the barometer kept on but barely weighted. Flight-validated 2026-11-13 (PX4 1.16.2): offboard takeoff to 1.5 m reaches 1.49-1.52 m with no height resets.

params.name: EKF2_BARO_CTRL
params.note: Keep ON. At 0 with HGT_REF 2, PX4 1.16 resets height to the rangefinder every 5 s (fixed on PX4 main 14da9d13b5, not in any release): a 0.2-0.3 m bob every 5 s.

params.name: EKF2_BARO_NOISE
params.note: Barometer barely weighted. Prop wash reads +5 m at liftoff and +2.8 m in hover; at the stock noise the EKF follows it and an offboard takeoff to 1.5 m sinks to about 0.3 m.

params.name: EKF2_TERR_NOISE
params.note: Steady floor estimate, so the rangefinder corrects height instead of being absorbed by the terrain state.

params.name: COM_ARM_WO_GPS
params.note: Without it arming is denied with 'Global position estimate required'.

tune-liion-4000.doc: PX4 autotune result, 2026-11-13, on the 6S 4000 mAh Li-ion pack strapped tight. The stock 4601 gains gave a pitch-only 8-9 Hz shake on battery (gyro std 3.7 deg/s pitch); autotuned: 2.0 deg/s. Unchanged from 4601: MC_ROLLRATE_D 0.001, all _FF and _K. One aircraft so far.

battery-6s-liion.doc: 6S 4000 mAh Li-ion. Per-cell voltages, sag-corrected by PX4. At BAT1_V_EMPTY 3.3 the pack reads 0% at the 3.3 V resting stop; at 3.2 the low warning lands near it.

profiles.name: DEXI-5 Indoor (flow + rangefinder)
profiles.description: Indoor flow + rangefinder navigation, the autotuned gains and the 6S Li-ion battery, layered on the 4601 airframe defaults. Flight-validated on one DEXI-5, 2026-11-13.
details: Height: rangefinder reference, barometer on at noise 15 (EKF2_BARO_CTRL 0 bobs every 5 s on PX4 1.16)
Tune: PX4 autotune on the 6S 4000 mAh Li-ion pack; rate gains about half of 4601
Battery: 6S Li-ion, empty 3.2 V / charged 4.15 V per cell
